*Mentor: Prof. Shashikant Pawar, Plaksha University.*

Ongoing work analyzing flow–structure interactions in collapsible tubes to study pressure and velocity fields in venous blood flow.

- Developing fluid–structure interaction (FSI) models alongside an experimental setup for tube deformation and flow measurements.
- Building a physics-informed inverse model using PINNs combined with CFD pipelines to validate experimental measurements.
